lines.text: Many learners say: I will go to shopping.

native.tip: 「買い物に行く」は go shopping。go swimming も同じで to は不要です。
native.caption: “I will go to shopping.”と言っていませんか？😅 「買い物に行く」の「に」を to にしてしまいがちです。“I will go shopping.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“swimming”。“I will go shopping.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: "Go shopping" is go shopping. The same goes for go swimming, to is unnecessary.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I will go to shopping.” 😅 Do not add to in go shopping. The natural way is “I will go shopping.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
